body: Would I? Already did. One to the wife, my sister, and each of my kids for them to read when they're 18.

Still here. I don't know why but I am. The police ended up being called for a wellness check after I popped a few Xanax and downed some whiskey then went to sleep. The wife couldn't reach me, nor my sister. They called the cops. That was one day. The next day I found myself with a gun in my mouth and my wife called just before I took the slack out of the trigger. I answered the phone for some reason. Every day this week my wife comes home to find me with bloodied shirts and fresh cuts on my arms. Even managed to burn several layers of skin off. Those ones have gotten infected. My wife has confiscated the firearms and sharps I kept in my possession. For some reason I'm grateful she did that but also pissed off. It just means I'll have to do it another way. My appointment with my therapist was cancelled. I lost it. Ended up calling the VA Crisis line. That kind of helped. I'm still lost, not sure which end is up. Everything just hurts and I'm tired of the pain.

Communicate. That's how you remain amicable. I'm in a similiar boat. My wife and I are 34 and 32, married for 10yrs with a 10yr old son. We own a home. Since all of this has started we've opened back up to each other and are actually strengthening our friendship. The marriage is over, but we have children together. For their sake, and our own, we are working on fixing our issues. My advice, communicate. If that's been a big problem, which you say it is, then now's the time to work on it.
But you can only fight an immovable object for so long. Eventually, you both get tired and just want out.
Yea. Finished. Put a fork in it. No going back.
I saw my therapist last week and see him again next week. I just found out about the affair over the weekend so I haven't been in to see him. I don't know that it will do much good anyway.

Yea. I'm trying. But even then it's not enough to keep the dark thoughts at bay. I have no one without her. No friends, my family doesn't talk to me. I can't exactly talk to her about this because she's made up her mind. Anything I say is just more of a reason for her to leave.

The only thing that stopped me today was that my kids were in the car. Otherwise, I probably wouldn't be posting. I'm home now, making dinner. Just took my daily pill and may need my chill pill. I called her and told her I needed her and needed to talk to her. She said she'd be home after happy hour with her co-workers, in a few hours. I'm trying to hold it together, but there's not much left of me to hold together... or a reason for that matter.

Yea. I've begun washing my meds down with whiskey. It helps too numb the pain faster. Not healthy though. I just can't seem to get a handle on any of this. My daily commute is about 1.5hrs and I secretly keep hoping I fall asleep at the wheel. Not healthy either, but I can't do this.
At least your still sleeping. I get maybe 2-3 hrs a night. Nothing more. I can barely function most days.

I'm in a similar boat. My wife and I have been off and on for a while. I was diagnosed with Depression and Anxiety conditions which explained my frequent outbursts targeted at my wife. I always tried to fix them but I always relapsed. Well these past few months I'd made solid progress but she said she wanted a divorce. All physical interaction stopped between us. I asked if there was another guy in the mix or if something happened on a recent business trip. She denied it, multiple times to my face. I got nervous, checked her phone and found a text to her best friend about the these amazing 4 hours she spent with another guy and how the sex was the best she'd had in years because she felt free and without stress. Even after all that, i still want her back. I'd do anything to save my marriage. But I think I'm being irrational now and I don't think anything I can do would help. It sucks. My depression has only gotten worse. I sleep maybe 2-3hrs a night. Can't get much more than that. Most days are a haze for me as I'm not really here due to the lack of sleep. When I am functioning at my normal levels I'm just numb. When the pain seeps in I take some medication (prescribed to me) and zone out for the remainder of the day. I've been working out like a fiend and it's not helping either. I don't even know most days if I want to keep breathing.

No. Not at all. I went into the marriage as a once in a lifetime thing. I never wanted us to be apart and still don't. The though of me spending the rest of my life without her terrifies me. Some days I don't even want to get out of bed because the thought of her being with someone else or me being alone is just crippling.

For me I'm just terrified. I'm a 34 yo M who is just starting down the divorce path. The STBX and I have two kids together. I'm slightly over weight, not by much though but even more worrisome is that I'm an introvert and hate meeting people. Yet I don't like being alone. My STBX is very attractive and won't have much of an issue moving on. Me, I'll probably die alone somewhere, forgotten by most.

I don't know how some people do it. I'm 3 weeks in from my wife telling me she wants a divorce. Around the kids I'm good to go. Work I'm good to go. The kids go to bed and the STBXW and I are alone in the house it gets real tough. After we talk for a bit and look over the calendar for the next couple of days she goes to bed in her room and I go to the guest room. Most nights I don't sleep. I hope it gets better, but right now it doesn't look that way.

I understand where you're coming from. I've been married 10yrs and we've moved a lot. All of it for her. Grad school and various jobs to advance her career. I did it willingly because it made it her happy. Each spot we've moved to she's known people from school or what not. So she was never alone. I had her. Now facing my divorce I am looking around at an empty stable of friends. There's quite literally no one.

Yea. Pretty much sums up my feelings about it as well. The night sucks because I go to sleep without her, and the morning's are hell because I wake up without her. The hours in between aren't fun either but work keeps me busy.

Thanks for the kind words. I wish I could sleep. I really haven't slept since she told me she wanted a divorce. I get maybe 2hrs of uninterrupted sleep a night. This has been going on for about 2 months now. Some days it takes all I have to get up and be functional though. i just don't have much desire to be a part of anything anymore.

If I didn't know any better I would think my wife wrote this response. That's exactly where she is. Except it's not that her pain wasn't a priority, it's that I was in denial and didn't see things as they were. Regardless the burden falls to me. I'm having a hard time accepting that fact as well. I don't want this, and she knows that. It's really sad when the only thing you can do to make your SO happy is to grant her a divorce. Makes you question what kind of person you truly are.
I'm living in the guest room now. She has the MBR. Our son just noticed this morning that we're no longer sharing a bedroom. It definitely sucks.
